title: Unconfirmed source-root opening notice names the failing check (diagnostic step toward the restart #2 unconfirmed-root cause)
outcome: The host's unconfirmed-source-root opening notice states which confirmation check failed, so the next live occurrence on a root session identifies its own cause, without changing which roots are confirmed.
acceptance: When a turn opens with an unconfirmed source root, the opening notice names the check that failed, in one bounded sentence that contains no path, store, id or secret.

Every Unconfirmed branch of the root capture and of the work-authority check has a test showing its reason. Each test also shows that the explained capture agrees with the unexplained one, so which roots are confirmed is unchanged.
The existing source-root naming, opening and authority tests pass on the candidate. Only signature-forced call-site edits are made to existing tests: false becomes None.

completion.summary: The unconfirmed source-root opening notice names the failed check, without changing which roots are confirmed. Landed in master 47fdba2f on 2026-11-03.
